results.title: Every document is counted the moment it arrives
results.expected: Every arrival has one count entry carrying its door, its time and a hash equal to the file's, and that entry comes before any filing, duplicate note or exception for it in the trace. A filing for an uncounted arrival fails.
results.actual: 62 port call(s): 5 counted, 5 filed, 0 listed (none), 0 duplicate(s), 10 field write(s), 0 close(s)
